project.name: B.E.A.R. D.O.W.N.
project.question: Q1 — Bayesian Deep Neural Network (CNN backbone + variational Bayesian head)
project.description: CNN backbone extracts features from GTZAN spectrograms. Bayesian classifier head models epistemic + aleatoric uncertainty using variational layers or Monte Carlo dropout.

bayesian.prior_notes: Priors define the distribution over weights p(w) = Normal(0, σ²). Posterior q(w|θ) learns mean and variance via variational inference. KL divergence between q and p regularizes overfitting.

uncertainty.description:
Predictive uncertainty is estimated by averaging outputs from multiple stochastic forward passes (T=mc_passes). Metrics: predictive entropy (total uncertainty)
          mutual information (epistemic uncertainty).
